_readme: How Helixora chooses which companies to cover. The screen (scripts/universe.mjs) runs monthly and publishes who qualifies; coverage changes are approved by hand and companies are never silently dropped.
rules: Listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or NYSE American (no OTC)
Burned more than $20M of operating cash in the latest fiscal year
Clinical stage: revenue under $50M, or under a quarter of cash burned
SEC industry code for drug developers (2834, 2836, 8731)
Trades at least $1M a day (3-month average)
At least one active, company-sponsored Phase II or III trial
selection: The 30 qualifying companies whose next Phase II or III trial finishes soonest.
funnel: Listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or NYSE American
Burned over $20M in operating cash in 2025
Has an active company-sponsored Phase II or III trial

grandfathered.IDYA: Did not pass the cash-burn or revenue rule (partner payments)
